dialogues.speaker: Yegana
dialogues.text: Oh! Okay, I've got it! Thank you, Collei!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: If you're interested, you can also read the section on Nilotpala Lotuses in "A Study of the Properties of Rainforest Vegetation."

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: If anything gives you trouble, come find me anytime and we can talk about it.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: *sigh*... I told you not to say thank you so much...

choices.text: Senior Researcher Collei! Always a pleasure!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! It's you! Please, don't tease me like that...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: No, no! I was just helping out my junior colleagues with some of their homework on plant identification, that's all...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: There were originally only supposed to be two or three people coming over for a quick study session, but I never imagined so many people would show up...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Once again, it was Master Tighnari who stepped in. He helped us reserve one of the bigger unused classrooms... We never could have had seats for everyone otherwise.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: It's just that... I had planned to sit down with everyone and review the questions together. But Master Tighnari made me go up to the podium...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: *sigh*... It was my first time up there! There were so many people down below that I froze. Couldn't say a single word...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I'd prepared for days in advance — even reorganized all my notes from my old patrols.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But once I was up there, my mind just went blank. I couldn't remember anything...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Thankfully, Master Tighnari did the introduction for me and had everyone say their piece. He then summarized all their questions... and left it to me to answer them.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I loosened up after answering the first few, and really started to get into it... By the end, I almost forgot he was still there. Hehe, I guess I must've been really focused!

choices.text: Looks like your hard work is paying off.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Yeah! And it's also thanks to everyone else's help, too. I...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You haven't forgotten to eat too, have you?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: *cough* That's right... I was just so busy today, I... haven't had much to eat since this morning...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I—I'm gonna go eat now! I still have to go be his teaching assistant later!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Hehe, maybe next time I'm up there on the podium, it'll be for an official lecture, not just tutoring!

choices.text: You did put in the effort, you know.
Definitely nailing that "senior role model" look!
